statement_summary: Written designation of cybersecurity lead, OT security lead, and Part 37 program owner
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Vendor security review and terms before connection or data access
Annual control assessment feeds the Part 37 program review
Retention of security program and regulatory records
Security-related information only for people on the RSO's information access list
MFA for all access; hardware keys for administrators and restricted library members
Same-day removal of accounts, Part 37 list entries, and badges at termination
Quarterly access reviews; monthly Part 37 list reconciliation
No default passwords on any device; credentials in the password vault
Vendor and MSP remote access with named accounts, MFA, and per-session OT approval
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Report suspected cyber activity at the security systems to the RSO at once
RSO decides Part 37 reportability; LLEA and State notice within 4 hours
Annual tabletop with the RSO, controls integrator, and alarm company
Security-Related files labeled and stored only in the restricted library or locked cabinet
Background investigation files restricted to the RSO and HR Manager
Regulatory records backed up separately, protected from alteration, restore-tested quarterly
Annual training, monthly reminders, quarterly phishing exercises, Part 37 information handling
No USB media or laptops on HMIs, PLCs, or security devices without approval
Approved generative AI tools only; no company data in public chatbots
